positions.commentary: The speaker argues that Cisco is super relevant because it offers a choice of silicon diversity, avoiding a monopoly.
The speaker states that they are huge fans of Nvidia products and chips, noting that customers love them.
The speaker describes a deep design partnership with Google that lasts for months before a deal is done.
The speaker warns that being a wrapper around Broadcom results in a very predatory monopoly.
The speaker mentions that China makes seven nanometer chips but does not make two nanometer chips.
